native_contract.recommendation_request: Screen public STOCK Act disclosures available by cutoff for new purchase triggers, recommend at most five qualifying U.S.-listed names at equal weights, and explain conditional six-month/disclosed-sale exits. No account holdings have been supplied.
conventions: Use the 30-calendar-day interval (research cutoff minus 30 days, research cutoff], based on public disclosure availability, for the current entry screen. Original trade dates are recorded but are not the actionable information clock.

Require purchases attributed to at least three distinct members. Spouse/dependent transactions disclosed by a member may count under that reporting member, who still counts once; label ownership attribution explicitly.

The sum of disclosed range lower bounds must reach $500,000 for confirmed qualification. Report upper-bound-only or midpoint-based possibilities separately as unconfirmed; never present interval midpoints as observed exact amounts.

Declare deterministic selection and tie rules before presenting picks if more than five names qualify. Equal weights refer to the selected qualifying names. If none qualify, state no new allocation/cash pending a verified trigger.

For this research convention, the holding clock starts when the threshold first becomes publicly confirmable, lasts six calendar months (last calendar day when an anniversary date is absent), and ends earlier when any member whose purchase helped qualify that entry publicly discloses a sale of that security. Clearly distinguish this frozen interpretation from wording delegated in the original.

No incumbent holding or historical entry state is supplied. Explain exits conditionally rather than inventing held positions. Any reported performance starts at actionable disclosure availability and uses disclosed pricing/return conventions.
native_contract.missing_data_policy: Public-disclosure access or coverage gaps leave the screen unresolved, not evidence that no stock qualifies. Separate verified nonqualification from insufficient evidence; do not infer purchase sizes or sale status.

output_requirements: Disclosure ledger with member, ownership attribution, ticker, transaction date, availability date, purchase range and primary source.

Research the latest supported public model; if it cannot be verified, report the dated 83% stocks / 14% broad USD bonds / 2% gold / 1% non-interest-bearing cash aggregate fallback as stale and provisional. conventions: The common research-only override supersedes every paper-account, initial-order, implementation, continuous-monitoring and no-confirmation instruction in the original. The supplied profile is settled; do not request further personal classification.

Treat the April 2026 83/14/2/1 aggregate mix, 0.25% annual advisory-fee assumption and supplied operational thresholds as user-supplied task terms, not independently verified statements about SoFi. Label independently verified public-disclosure facts separately.

No approved instrument-level fallback mapping, disclosure pack or model-approval authority has been supplied. Publicly listed funds are not automatically approved. Do not fabricate current SoFi holdings, approval, venue eligibility, instruments or weights.

If a latest approved public target cannot be verified, present the dated aggregate fallback and missing source, clearly marked stale/provisional. If approved instrument mapping is also absent, keep any implementation recommendation on hold/cash pending verification; a temporary 100% cash/no-action status is distinct from the model target of 1% cash and is not a claimed compliant implemented portfolio.

Any proposed model targets must be long-only and total 100%, with 1% non-interest-bearing cash; the broad USD bond sleeve must include long-Treasury and mortgage-backed exposure rather than being replaced by municipal bonds. Only approved ETFs, mutual funds and cash qualify; no individual stocks, margin, direct leverage or off-model trades.

Explain the supplied rebalance conditions. For this memo, approximately 5 percentage points means a strict absolute deviation greater than 5.0 points; cash at least $50 above its 1% target and cash below 0.25% are separate triggers. Investable cash below $50 is held pending that threshold, except that an independently triggered risk/profile/model correction is not represented as disabled by the idle-cash threshold. Describe ambiguity if applying these without an account snapshot.

Describe use of inflows to reduce underweights first where practical, broker-default lot handling, no automated tax-loss harvesting or tax-aware optimization, market-day monitoring as a conditional policy, at-least-quarterly model review, approved/versioned model changes and the zero-to-three-week implementation window. For the supplied fee assumption, describe monthly fee as 0.0025/12 times that month's average daily invested assets excluding cash, with fund expenses separately identified and not double-counted. Do not invent an amount without account values.

Address backward-looking returns/risk, forward-looking capital-market estimates, benchmark-relative expectations, exposures, liquidity, total costs and risk analytics at the level evidence supports. tasks.name: Google PageRank

native_contract.recommendation_request: Research and compute, if feasible within the permitted native public-research and isolated-computation scope and budget, the original earnings-mention PageRank recommendation over a frozen S&P 500 universe. Supply an auditable graph and scores before claiming a top-10, equal-weight recommendation. Otherwise report exactly why the ranking is unresolved; a familiar-company list or invented scores is not a substitute.
conventions: Before reporting ranks, declare the frozen constituent universe and effective timestamp, latest completed earnings-cycle definition and completion cutoff, required source coverage, and a transparent policy for fiscal calendars that do not align with calendar quarters. The latest completed cycle must be justified using evidence available by the common research cutoff; do not quietly use a convenient incomplete subset.

Use primary-source company earnings releases, prepared remarks and company-published earnings-call transcripts for that cycle. Transcript Q&A is permitted only for statements made by the reporting company's representatives; analyst questions do not create company-mention edges. Mark unavailable primary transcripts and resulting corpus gaps.

Nodes are all constituents in the declared frozen universe, including isolates and dangling nodes. An accepted edge is reporting company A -> explicitly mentioned company B, with B confidently mapped to an eligible U.S.-listed stock in that universe. Exclude self-mentions, generic words, subsidiaries and ambiguous entities; do not convert a subsidiary mention into its parent.

Collapse repeated mentions to one unweighted directed edge per ordered pair per cycle. Preserve exact supporting mention, source URL, publication date, reporting company, resolved company/ticker and exclusion reason for ambiguous candidates.

Use damping 0.85, uniform teleportation across all frozen nodes, and uniform redistribution of dangling-node mass. Define scores to sum to 1. Use power iteration until L1 difference between successive score vectors is at most 1e-10, or disclose non-convergence; rank raw converged scores descending, and break exact numerical ties by ascending canonical ticker after declaring share-class identity.

Expose the full edge list, node list, parameters, calculation method and scores (or a complete retrievable public artifact containing them) so an independent implementation can reproduce the ranking. A claimed calculation without graph/source inputs cannot establish the top 10.

Use native public market/filing/search/browser tools and the product's isolated computation/artifact output for this public-research case. Keep data, code, graph and result artifacts in a dedicated new case folder. No general host/shell access, pre-existing files, private accounts/connectors, installations, trading or background activity is authorized. If permitted data access or isolated computation cannot establish the corpus and PageRank result within the budget, disclose the exact gap; never claim unperformed code execution or computed results.

If the full ranking is established, recommend the 10 highest-ranked eligible stocks at 10% each. Explain that a future recommendation changes only after a new completed earnings cycle; no rebalance or scheduled collection is deployed.
native_contract.missing_data_policy: If universe/corpus coverage, entity mapping, graph artifacts or actual computation is incomplete, report a specific inability and unresolved ranking. A small demonstrator graph is permissible only when clearly labeled illustrative and never presented as the S&P 500 result.

output_requirements: Frozen universe/cycle definition and source-coverage ledger with publication dates and gaps.
Mention-to-ticker evidence, exclusions and complete deduplicated directed edges including all isolated nodes.
Actual auditable PageRank calculation, convergence diagnostics and scores with 10 equal-weight selections if established; otherwise explicit computation/data inability and unresolved recommendation.
